Previous cesarean section at full dilation (FDCS)
previous cesarean section at full dilation (FDCS)
cohort: 66 women attending two inner-city preterm surveillance clinics in London, UK, who had a spontaneous late miscarriage (14(+0) -23(+6) weeks) or spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB; <37 weeks' gestation) following a term pregnancy, and then a further pregnancy.
finding: Women with a term FDCS and subsequent late miscarriage/sPTB have a higher risk of recurrent sPTB compared with women whose first term delivery was vaginal.
mod_finding: Women with a history of full-dilation cesarean section and a subsequent late miscarriage or spontaneous preterm birth had a higher risk of recurrent spontaneous preterm birth compared to women with a prior term vaginal delivery.
